CONNECT PUTS THE ERG INTO A JUST ROW SESSION. The only thing that changes on the phone is one line of the Ready frame, and it branches on what the machine reports back: A when the PM5 confirms the Just Row program (its readback flips to the type it uses for its own Just Row), B — today's line, unchanged — when it does not. The erg's own screen is the real change; the walk leg photographs it beside copy A.

CONTRAST: ink-2 on page (body line) 9.74 · marker on sunken (strip) 5.50 · ink on page 15.41 · on-color on accent 5.94.
